name: observed-ego-side-switch-dev-v1
evidence_scope: Consumed development diagnosis only; no fresh confirmation, blind, submission, or SOTA promotion.
hypothesis: Late obstacle-side reselection should require the proposed passing side to agree with the obstacle's observed position relative to the vehicle image center. This permits the centered-obstacle switch that prevented a third contact on screen track1/3892761381, while blocking the opposite flip on consumed seed42 where the obstacle remained far left of the car.
single_factor_from_margin: Change only the predicate for switching an already selected obstacle-passing side. Keep first selection, detector, road/centerline/margin perception, obstacle urgency, speed and all public actions unchanged. Permit switch for y<38; for 38<=y<52 require candidate_side*(IMAGE_CENTER-obstacle_x)>0; reject switch for y>=52.
source_lineage: Baseline and margin are the exact frozen source snapshots from observed-margin-generalization-v1. Ego-switch is committed agent.py bytes with SHA256 cbfd1a544dd3eef30a193f97b93612ab67126fbc1d3cb41fd0027f08c997dd19, replacing the sole '_CompoundClearingBrakeCarryController()' route-constructor occurrence with '_ObservedEgoSideSwitchController()'. The new base hook's default returns the original y<SIDE_SWITCH_ROW condition for all existing classes; focused tests and stored-observation parity must verify no unintended control/margin behavior change.
budget: One cold-process official-generator episode per arm and exact development cell: 23 cells x 3 arms = 69 executions. Continue through all cells unless an operational failure; source/model/helper/harness/environment hashes remain fixed. No new geometry seed may be substituted or added after results.
comparison: Compare ego_switch versus baseline and versus margin with the same strict paired safety veto: reject any lost prior finish, increased contacts or damage, lower paired DNF progress, or any shared completed lap more than 5% slower. Against baseline, retain only a lexicographic gain in finish count, mean progress, or shared completed time. Against margin, also count an otherwise tied comparison with at least one paired contact/damage reduction and no lap slowdown as RETAIN_SAFETY_REPAIR. Overall diagnostic retention requires baseline RETAIN and margin RETAIN or RETAIN_SAFETY_REPAIR. The margin-versus-baseline comparison is context only. One repaired consumed cell cannot establish unseen-track improvement.
expected_mechanism_checks: baseline behavior identical after hook refactor
screen track1/3892761381 side switch at step259 allowed and extra contact removed
seed42 late flip at step196 blocked without off-track or collision regression
seed11/21 recovered finishes and track2/644062 contacts unchanged
